```diff
- 
+ # 🗺️ Google Maps API - Setup e Configurazione
+ 
+ &gt; **Creato:** 2026-01-06  
+ &gt; **Scopo:** Documentare la configurazione delle Google Maps API per la funzionalità Building Address Autocomplete
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 📋 Panoramica
+ 
+ SunPulse utilizza le Google Maps API per:
+ - **Places Autocomplete**: ricerca indirizzi durante la creazione edifici
+ - **Geocoding**: conversione indirizzo → coordinate GPS (lat/lng)
+ - **Timezone API**: rilevamento automatico timezone da coordinate
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🔑 Ottenere API Key
+ 
+ ### 1. Creare Progetto Google Cloud
+ 
+ 1. Vai su [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/)
+ 2. Crea un nuovo progetto o seleziona uno esistente
+ 3. Nome suggerito: &#96;sunpulse-production&#96;
+ 
+ ### 2. Abilitare API Necessarie
+ 
+ Nel progetto, abilita le seguenti API:
+ 
+ | API | Descrizione | Costo Stimato |
+ |-----|-------------|---------------|
+ | **Places API** | Autocomplete indirizzi | ~€17/1000 richieste |
+ | **Geocoding API** | Indirizzo → coordinate | ~€5/1000 richieste |
+ | **Time Zone API** | Coordinate → timezone | ~€5/1000 richieste |
+ | **Maps JavaScript API** | Mappa interattiva (frontend) | Gratuito fino a 28.000 caricamenti/mese |
+ 
+ ### 3. Creare API Key
+ 
+ 1. Vai su **API e servizi** → **Credenziali**
+ 2. Clicca **+ CREA CREDENZIALI** → **Chiave API**
+ 3. Copia la chiave generata
+ 
+ ### 4. Configurare Restrizioni (IMPORTANTE!)
+ 
+ Per sicurezza, configura restrizioni sulla chiave:
+ 
+ #### Backend Key (per server-side)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ Tipo: Restrizioni IP
+ IP consentiti: 
+   - IP del server di produzione
+   - 127.0.0.1 (per sviluppo locale)
+ 
+ API consentite:
+   - Places API
+   - Geocoding API
+   - Time Zone API
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### Frontend Key (per client-side)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ Tipo: Restrizioni HTTP referrer
+ Referrer consentiti:
+   - https://yourdomain.com/*
+   - http://localhost:3000/* (per sviluppo)
+ 
+ API consentite:
+   - Maps JavaScript API
+   - Places API (solo Autocomplete)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ &gt; ⚠️ **Nota**: È consigliato usare **2 chiavi separate** (una per backend, una per frontend)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## ⚙️ Configurazione Applicazione
+ 
+ ### Backend (.env)
+ 
+ Aggiungi al file &#96;.env&#96; del backend:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Google APIs
+ GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Frontend (.env)
+ 
+ Aggiungi al file &#96;.env&#96; del frontend:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Google Maps API (per Address Autocomplete)
+ VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=AIzaSyYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Verifica Configurazione
+ 
+ Il file &#96;index.html&#96; carica automaticamente lo script Google Maps:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;html
+ &lt;script&gt;
+   (function() {
+     const apiKey = import.meta.env?.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY;
+     if (apiKey &amp;&amp; apiKey !== 'your-google-maps-api-key') {
+       const script = document.createElement('script');
+       script.src = &#96;https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${apiKey}&amp;libraries=places&amp;language=it&#96;;
+       script.async = true;
+       script.defer = true;
+       document.head.appendChild(script);
+     }
+   })();
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 💰 Costi Stimati
+ 
+ ### Scenario: 100 utenti attivi
+ 
+ | Operazione | Frequenza | Richieste/mese | Costo/mese |
+ |------------|-----------|----------------|------------|
+ | Autocomplete indirizzo | 1 per nuovo edificio | ~100 | €1.70 |
+ | Geocoding | 1 per nuovo edificio | ~100 | €0.50 |
+ | Timezone | 1 per nuovo edificio | ~100 | €0.50 |
+ | **TOTALE** | | **~300** | **~€2.70** |
+ 
+ ### Free Tier Google Maps
+ 
+ Google offre **$200 di credito mensile gratuito**, che copre:
+ - ~11.700 richieste Autocomplete
+ - ~40.000 richieste Geocoding
+ - ~40.000 richieste Timezone
+ 
+ &gt; ✅ **Per la maggior parte dei casi d'uso, l'utilizzo rientra nel free tier!**
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🧪 Test Configurazione
+ 
+ ### Test Backend (Python)
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ import googlemaps
+ import os
+ 
+ gmaps = googlemaps.Client(key=os.getenv('GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY'))
+ 
+ # Test Geocoding
+ result = gmaps.geocode('Via Roma 1, Milano')
+ print(f"Coordinate: {result[0]['geometry']['location']}")
+ 
+ # Test Timezone
+ import datetime
+ timezone = gmaps.timezone(
+     location=(45.4642, 9.1900),
+     timestamp=datetime.datetime.now()
+ )
+ print(f"Timezone: {timezone['timeZoneId']}")
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Test Frontend (Browser Console)
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;javascript
+ // Verifica che lo script sia caricato
+ console.log('Google Maps loaded:', typeof google !== 'undefined');
+ 
+ // Test Autocomplete
+ const service = new google.maps.places.AutocompleteService();
+ service.getPlacePredictions(
+   { input: 'Via Roma, Milano' },
+   (predictions, status) =&gt; {
+     console.log('Predictions:', predictions);
+   }
+ );
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🔒 Sicurezza
+ 
+ ### Best Practices
+ 
+ 1. **Mai committare API key nel codice**
+    - Usa sempre variabili ambiente
+    - Aggiungi &#96;.env&#96; al &#96;.gitignore&#96;
+ 
+ 2. **Usa restrizioni appropriate**
+    - IP per backend
+    - HTTP referrer per frontend
+ 
+ 3. **Monitora utilizzo**
+    - Configura alert su Google Cloud Console
+    - Imposta budget limit (es: €10/mese)
+ 
+ 4. **Ruota le chiavi periodicamente**
+    - Ogni 6-12 mesi
+    - Immediatamente se compromesse
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🐛 Troubleshooting
+ 
+ ### Errore: "This API project is not authorized to use this API"
+ 
+ **Soluzione**: Abilita l'API nel progetto Google Cloud
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Vai su Google Cloud Console
+ # → API e servizi → Libreria
+ # → Cerca "Places API" → Abilita
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Errore: "API key not valid"
+ 
+ **Soluzione**: Verifica restrizioni API key
+ 
+ 1. Controlla che l'IP/referrer sia consentito
+ 2. Verifica che l'API sia abilitata per quella chiave
+ 
+ ### Errore: "REQUEST_DENIED"
+ 
+ **Soluzione**: Controlla fatturazione
+ 
+ 1. Vai su **Fatturazione** in Google Cloud Console
+ 2. Assicurati che il progetto abbia un metodo di pagamento valido
+ 
+ ---
```

```diff
+ /**

+ 
+ export interface BuildingWeather {

+ 
+ export interface UserBuilding {

+ export interface BuildingDevice {
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * AddressAutocomplete Component
+  * 
+  * Componente per la ricerca di indirizzi con Google Places Autocomplete
+  * Include preview mappa con marker della posizione selezionata
+  */
+ 
+ import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
+ import { Input, Card, List, Spin, Alert, Typography } from 'antd';
+ import { EnvironmentOutlined, LoadingOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
+ import type { PlacePrediction, AddressDetailsResponse } from '../../types/building';
+ import axios from 'axios';
+ 
+ const { Text } = Typography;
+ 
+ interface AddressAutocompleteProps {
+   value?: string;
+   onChange?: (address: string, details: AddressDetailsResponse | null) =&gt; void;
+   placeholder?: string;
+   disabled?: boolean;
+   showMap?: boolean;
+   mapHeight?: number;
+ }
+ 
+ const AddressAutocomplete: React.FC&lt;AddressAutocompleteProps&gt; = ({
+   value = '',
+   onChange,
+   placeholder = 'Cerca indirizzo...',
+   disabled = false,
+   showMap = true,
+   mapHeight = 300,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(value);
+   const [predictions, setPredictions] = useState&lt;PlacePrediction[]&gt;([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+   const [selectedDetails, setSelectedDetails] = useState&lt;AddressDetailsResponse | null&gt;(null);
+   const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+   const [showPredictions, setShowPredictions] = useState(false);
+   
+   const mapRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+   const mapInstanceRef = useRef&lt;google.maps.Map | null&gt;(null);
+   const markerRef = useRef&lt;google.maps.Marker | null&gt;(null);
+   const debounceTimerRef = useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null);
+ 
+   // Inizializza la mappa
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!showMap || !mapRef.current) return;
+ 
+     // Verifica che Google Maps sia caricato
+     if (typeof google === 'undefined' || !google.maps) {
+       console.warn('Google Maps API non caricata');
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     // Crea mappa centrata sull'Italia
+     const map = new google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
+       center: { lat: 41.9028, lng: 12.4964 }, // Roma
+       zoom: 6,
+       mapTypeControl: false,
+       streetViewControl: false,
+       fullscreenControl: false,
+     });
+ 
+     mapInstanceRef.current = map;
+ 
+     // Crea marker (inizialmente nascosto)
+     const marker = new google.maps.Marker({
+       map,
+       visible: false,
+     });
+ 
+     markerRef.current = marker;
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       marker.setMap(null);
+     };
+   }, [showMap]);
+ 
+   // Aggiorna marker quando cambiano i dettagli
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!selectedDetails || !mapInstanceRef.current || !markerRef.current) return;
+ 
+     const { latitude, longitude } = selectedDetails;
+     const position = { lat: latitude, lng: longitude };
+ 
+     // Aggiorna posizione marker
+     markerRef.current.setPosition(position);
+     markerRef.current.setVisible(true);
+ 
+     // Centra mappa
+     mapInstanceRef.current.setCenter(position);
+     mapInstanceRef.current.setZoom(15);
+   }, [selectedDetails]);
+ 
+   // Fetch predictions da backend
+   const fetchPredictions = useCallback(async (input: string) =&gt; {
+     if (!input || input.length &lt; 3) {
+       setPredictions([]);
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     setLoading(true);
+     setError(null);
+ 
+     try {
+       const response = await axios.get&lt;{ predictions: PlacePrediction[] }&gt;(
+         &#96;${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL}/address/autocomplete&#96;,
+         {
+           params: { q: input },
+         }
+       );
+ 
+       setPredictions(response.data.predictions || []);
+       setShowPredictions(true);
+     } catch (err: any) {
+       console.error('Errore autocomplete:', err);
+       setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Errore durante la ricerca');
+       setPredictions([]);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   }, []);
+ 
+   // Fetch dettagli indirizzo da place_id
+   const fetchPlaceDetails = useCallback(async (placeId: string) =&gt; {
+     setLoading(true);
+     setError(null);
+ 
+     try {
+       const response = await axios.get&lt;AddressDetailsResponse&gt;(
+         &#96;${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL}/address/details/${placeId}&#96;
+       );
+ 
+       setSelectedDetails(response.data);
+       
+       // Notifica il parent component
+       if (onChange) {
+         onChange(response.data.formatted_address, response.data);
+       }
+     } catch (err: any) {
+       console.error('Errore dettagli indirizzo:', err);
+       setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Errore durante il recupero dei dettagli');
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   }, [onChange]);
+ 
+   // Handler input change con debounce
+   const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {
+     const newValue = e.target.value;
+     setInputValue(newValue);
+ 
+     // Clear previous timer
+     if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
+       clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
+     }
+ 
+     // Set new timer
+     debounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       fetchPredictions(newValue);
+     }, 300);
+   };
+ 
+   // Handler selezione prediction
+   const handleSelectPrediction = (prediction: PlacePrediction) =&gt; {
+     setInputValue(prediction.description);
+     setShowPredictions(false);
+     fetchPlaceDetails(prediction.place_id);
+   };
+ 
+   // Handler focus input
+   const handleFocus = () =&gt; {
+     if (predictions.length &gt; 0) {
+       setShowPredictions(true);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   // Handler blur input (con delay per permettere click su lista)
+   const handleBlur = () =&gt; {
+     setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       setShowPredictions(false);
+     }, 200);
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div style={{ position: 'relative' }}&gt;
+       {/* Input con icona */}
+       &lt;Input
+         value={inputValue}
+         onChange={handleInputChange}
+         onFocus={handleFocus}
+         onBlur={handleBlur}
+         placeholder={placeholder}
+         disabled={disabled}
+         prefix={&lt;EnvironmentOutlined /&gt;}
+         suffix={loading ? &lt;LoadingOutlined spin /&gt; : null}
+         size="large"
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Lista predictions */}
+       {showPredictions &amp;&amp; predictions.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;Card
+           style={{
+             position: 'absolute',
+             top: '100%',
+             left: 0,
+             right: 0,
+             zIndex: 1000,
+             marginTop: 4,
+             maxHeight: 300,
+             overflow: 'auto',
+             boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)',
+           }}
+           bodyStyle={{ padding: 0 }}
+         &gt;
+           &lt;List
+             dataSource={predictions}
+             renderItem={(prediction) =&gt; (
+               &lt;List.Item
+                 style={{
+                   cursor: 'pointer',
+                   padding: '12px 16px',
+                 }}
+                 onClick={() =&gt; handleSelectPrediction(prediction)}
+                 onMouseEnter={(e) =&gt; {
+                   e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = '#f5f5f5';
+                 }}
+                 onMouseLeave={(e) =&gt; {
+                   e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
+                 }}
+               &gt;
+                 &lt;List.Item.Meta
+                   avatar={&lt;EnvironmentOutlined style={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#1890ff' }} /&gt;}
+                   title={prediction.structured_formatting.main_text}
+                   description={
+                     &lt;Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}&gt;
+                       {prediction.structured_formatting.secondary_text}
+                     &lt;/Text&gt;
+                   }
+                 /&gt;
+               &lt;/List.Item&gt;
+             )}
+           /&gt;
+         &lt;/Card&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {/* Errore */}
+       {error &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;Alert
+           message={error}
+           type="error"
+           closable
+           onClose={() =&gt; setError(null)}
+           style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
+         /&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {/* Mappa */}
+       {showMap &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div
+           ref={mapRef}
+           style={{
+             width: '100%',
+             height: mapHeight,
+             marginTop: 16,
+             borderRadius: 8,
+             overflow: 'hidden',
+             border: '1px solid #d9d9d9',
+           }}
+         /&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {/* Dettagli indirizzo selezionato */}
+       {selectedDetails &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;Card size="small" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}&gt;
+           &lt;Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}&gt;
+             &lt;strong&gt;Coordinate:&lt;/strong&gt; {selectedDetails.latitude.toFixed(6)}, {selectedDetails.longitude.toFixed(6)}
+             {selectedDetails.timezone &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;&gt;
+                 {' | '}
+                 &lt;strong&gt;Timezone:&lt;/strong&gt; {selectedDetails.timezone}
+               &lt;/&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/Text&gt;
+         &lt;/Card&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default AddressAutocomplete;
+ 
```

</details>

```diff
+ /**
+  * useBuildings Hook
+  * 
+  * Hook per la gestione degli edifici (CRUD operations)
+  */
+ 
+ import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+ import axios from 'axios';
+ import type {
+   Building,
+   BuildingListResponse,
+   CreateBuildingRequest,
+   UpdateBuildingRequest,
+   BuildingDevicesResponse,
+   BuildingMembersResponse,
+   AddDeviceToBuildingRequest,
+   InviteMemberRequest,
+   UpdateMemberRoleRequest,
+ } from '../types/building';
+ 
+ const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL;
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // Query Keys
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ export const buildingKeys = {
+   all: ['buildings'] as const,
+   lists: () =&gt; [...buildingKeys.all, 'list'] as const,
+   list: (filters: string) =&gt; [...buildingKeys.lists(), { filters }] as const,
+   details: () =&gt; [...buildingKeys.all, 'detail'] as const,
+   detail: (id: number) =&gt; [...buildingKeys.details(), id] as const,
+   devices: (id: number) =&gt; [...buildingKeys.detail(id), 'devices'] as const,
+   members: (id: number) =&gt; [...buildingKeys.detail(id), 'members'] as const,
+   weather: (id: number) =&gt; [...buildingKeys.detail(id), 'weather'] as const,
+ };
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // API Functions
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ const fetchBuildings = async (): Promise&lt;Building[]&gt; =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.get&lt;BuildingListResponse&gt;(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/&#96;);
+   return data.buildings;
+ };
+ 
+ const fetchBuilding = async (id: number): Promise&lt;Building&gt; =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.get&lt;Building&gt;(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${id}&#96;);
+   return data;
+ };
+ 
+ const createBuilding = async (building: CreateBuildingRequest): Promise&lt;Building&gt; =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.post&lt;Building&gt;(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/&#96;, building);
+   return data;
+ };
+ 
+ const updateBuilding = async ({ id, ...building }: UpdateBuildingRequest &amp; { id: number }): Promise&lt;Building&gt; =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.put&lt;Building&gt;(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${id}&#96;, building);
+   return data;
+ };
+ 
+ const deleteBuilding = async (id: number): Promise&lt;void&gt; =&gt; {
+   await axios.delete(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${id}&#96;);
+ };
+ 
+ const fetchBuildingDevices = async (buildingId: number) =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.get&lt;BuildingDevicesResponse&gt;(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${buildingId}/devices&#96;);
+   return data.devices;
+ };
+ 
+ const addDeviceToBuilding = async ({ buildingId, ...device }: AddDeviceToBuildingRequest &amp; { buildingId: number }) =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.post(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${buildingId}/devices&#96;, device);
+   return data;
+ };
+ 
+ const removeDeviceFromBuilding = async ({ buildingId, deviceId }: { buildingId: number; deviceId: number }) =&gt; {
+   await axios.delete(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${buildingId}/devices/${deviceId}&#96;);
+ };
+ 
+ const fetchBuildingMembers = async (buildingId: number) =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.get&lt;BuildingMembersResponse&gt;(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${buildingId}/members&#96;);
+   return data.members;
+ };
+ 
+ const inviteMember = async ({ buildingId, ...member }: InviteMemberRequest &amp; { buildingId: number }) =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.post(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${buildingId}/members&#96;, member);
+   return data;
+ };
+ 
+ const updateMemberRole = async ({ buildingId, userId, ...role }: UpdateMemberRoleRequest &amp; { buildingId: number; userId: number }) =&gt; {
+   const { data } = await axios.put(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${buildingId}/members/${userId}&#96;, role);
+   return data;
+ };
+ 
+ const removeMember = async ({ buildingId, userId }: { buildingId: number; userId: number }) =&gt; {
+   await axios.delete(&#96;${API_URL}/buildings/${buildingId}/members/${userId}&#96;);
+ };
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // Hooks
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per ottenere la lista di tutti gli edifici dell'utente
+  */
+ export const useBuildings = () =&gt; {
+   return useQuery({
+     queryKey: buildingKeys.lists(),
+     queryFn: fetchBuildings,
+     staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minuti
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per ottenere i dettagli di un edificio specifico
+  */
+ export const useBuilding = (id: number) =&gt; {
+   return useQuery({
+     queryKey: buildingKeys.detail(id),
+     queryFn: () =&gt; fetchBuilding(id),
+     enabled: !!id,
+     staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per creare un nuovo edificio
+  */
+ export const useCreateBuilding = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: createBuilding,
+     onSuccess: () =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.lists() });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per aggiornare un edificio
+  */
+ export const useUpdateBuilding = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: updateBuilding,
+     onSuccess: (data) =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.lists() });
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.detail(data.id) });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per eliminare un edificio
+  */
+ export const useDeleteBuilding = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: deleteBuilding,
+     onSuccess: () =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.lists() });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per ottenere i dispositivi di un edificio
+  */
+ export const useBuildingDevices = (buildingId: number) =&gt; {
+   return useQuery({
+     queryKey: buildingKeys.devices(buildingId),
+     queryFn: () =&gt; fetchBuildingDevices(buildingId),
+     enabled: !!buildingId,
+     staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000, // 2 minuti
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per aggiungere un dispositivo a un edificio
+  */
+ export const useAddDeviceToBuilding = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: addDeviceToBuilding,
+     onSuccess: (_, variables) =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.devices(variables.buildingId) });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per rimuovere un dispositivo da un edificio
+  */
+ export const useRemoveDeviceFromBuilding = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: removeDeviceFromBuilding,
+     onSuccess: (_, variables) =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.devices(variables.buildingId) });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per ottenere i membri di un edificio
+  */
+ export const useBuildingMembers = (buildingId: number) =&gt; {
+   return useQuery({
+     queryKey: buildingKeys.members(buildingId),
+     queryFn: () =&gt; fetchBuildingMembers(buildingId),
+     enabled: !!buildingId,
+     staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per invitare un membro a un edificio
+  */
+ export const useInviteMember = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: inviteMember,
+     onSuccess: (_, variables) =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.members(variables.buildingId) });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per aggiornare il ruolo di un membro
+  */
+ export const useUpdateMemberRole = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: updateMemberRole,
+     onSuccess: (_, variables) =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.members(variables.buildingId) });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook per rimuovere un membro da un edificio
+  */
+ export const useRemoveMember = () =&gt; {
+   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+ 
+   return useMutation({
+     mutationFn: removeMember,
+     onSuccess: (_, variables) =&gt; {
+       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: buildingKeys.members(variables.buildingId) });
+     },
+   });
+ };
+
```

```diff
+ @celery_app.task(bind=True, max_retries=2)
+ def collect_weather_data(self):
+     """Task Celery: Raccolta dati meteo per tutti gli edifici"""
+     task_id = self.request.id
+     start_time = datetime.utcnow()
+     
+     logger.info("Starting weather data collection", task_id=task_id)
+     
+     try:
+         result = asyncio.run(_collect_weather_data_async())
+         
+         duration = (datetime.utcnow() - start_time).total_seconds()
+         logger.info(
+             "Weather data collection completed",
+             task_id=task_id,
+             duration_seconds=duration,
+             **result
+         )
+         
+         return result
+         
+     except Exception as e:
+         logger.error(
+             "Weather data collection failed",
+             task_id=task_id,
+             error=str(e),
+             retry_count=self.request.retries
+         )
+         
+         countdown = 2 ** self.request.retries
+         raise self.retry(exc=e, countdown=countdown, max_retries=2)
+ 
+ 
+ async def _collect_weather_data_async() -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+     """Implementazione async della raccolta dati meteo"""
+     from ..services.weather_service import WeatherService
+     from ..services.database import get_db_session
+     from ..models.building import Building, BuildingWeather
+     from sqlalchemy import select
+     
+     weather_service = WeatherService()
+     buildings_processed = 0
+     errors = 0
+     error_messages = []
+     
+     try:
+         # Ottieni tutti gli edifici con coordinate GPS
+         async with get_db_session() as session:
+             result = await session.execute(
+                 select(Building).where(
+                     Building.latitude.isnot(None),
+                     Building.longitude.isnot(None)
+                 )
+             )
+             buildings = result.scalars().all()
+             
+             logger.info(f"Found {len(buildings)} buildings with GPS coordinates")
+             
+             # Fetch weather per ogni edificio
+             for building in buildings:
+                 try:
+                     weather_data = await weather_service.fetch_weather(
+                         latitude=building.latitude,
+                         longitude=building.longitude
+                     )
+                     
+                     if weather_data:
+                         # Salva dati meteo nel database
+                         await weather_service.save_weather_data(
+                             session=session,
+                             building_id=building.id,
+                             weather_data=weather_data
+                         )
+                         
+                         buildings_processed += 1
+                         
+                         logger.debug(
+                             "Weather data saved",
+                             building_id=building.id,
+                             building_name=building.name,
+                             temperature=weather_data.get("temperature")
+                         )
+                     else:
+                         errors += 1
+                         error_messages.append(f"Building {building.id}: No weather data")
+                         
+                 except Exception as e:
+                     errors += 1
+                     error_messages.append(f"Building {building.id}: {str(e)}")
+                     logger.error(
+                         "Error fetching weather for building",
+                         building_id=building.id,
+                         error=str(e)
+                     )
+             
+             await session.commit()
+         
+         return {
+             "buildings_processed": buildings_processed,
+             "errors": errors,
+             "error_messages": error_messages if error_messages else None,
+             "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
+         }
+         
+     except Exception as e:
+         logger.error("Error in weather data collection", error=str(e), exc_info=True)
+         return {
+             "buildings_processed": buildings_processed,
+             "errors": errors + 1,
+             "error_messages": [str(e)],
+             "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
+         }
+ 
+ 
+ @celery_app.task(bind=True)
+ def cleanup_weather_history(self):
+     """Task Celery: Pulizia storico meteo più vecchio di 30 giorni"""
+     task_id = self.request.id
+     logger.info("Starting weather history cleanup", task_id=task_id)
+     
+     try:
+         result = asyncio.run(_cleanup_weather_history_async())
+         logger.info("Weather history cleanup completed", task_id=task_id, **result)
+         return result
+         
+     except Exception as e:
+         logger.error("Weather history cleanup failed", task_id=task_id, error=str(e))
+         return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}
+ 
+ 
+ async def _cleanup_weather_history_async() -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+     """Implementazione async della pulizia storico meteo"""
+     from ..services.database import get_db_session
+     from ..models.building import BuildingWeather
+     from sqlalchemy import delete
+     
+     try:
+         # Elimina record più vecchi di 30 giorni
+         cutoff_date = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=30)
+         
+         async with get_db_session() as session:
+             result = await session.execute(
+                 delete(BuildingWeather).where(
+                     BuildingWeather.fetched_at &lt; cutoff_date
+                 )
+             )
+             
+             deleted_count = result.rowcount
+             await session.commit()
+             
+             logger.info(
+                 "Weather history cleaned up",
+                 deleted_records=deleted_count,
+                 cutoff_date=cutoff_date.isoformat()
+             )
+             
+             return {
+                 "success": True,
+                 "deleted_records": deleted_count,
+                 "cutoff_date": cutoff_date.isoformat()
+             }
+             
+     except Exception as e:
+         logger.error("Error cleaning up weather history", error=str(e), exc_info=True)
+         return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,72 @@
- 
+ /**
+  * useSelectedBuilding Hook
+  * 
+  * Hook per gestire l'edificio attualmente selezionato dall'utente
+  * Persiste la selezione in localStorage
+  */
+ 
+ import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { useBuildings } from './useBuildings';
+ import type { Building } from '../types/building';
+ 
+ const STORAGE_KEY = 'selectedBuildingId';
+ 
+ export const useSelectedBuilding = () =&gt; {
+   const { data: buildings, isLoading, error } = useBuildings();
+   
+   const [selectedBuildingId, setSelectedBuildingId] = useState&lt;number | null&gt;(() =&gt; {
+     const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
+     return saved ? parseInt(saved, 10) : null;
+   });
+ 
+   // Auto-seleziona primo edificio se non c'è selezione
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (buildings &amp;&amp; buildings.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !selectedBuildingId) {
+       const firstBuildingId = buildings[0].id;
+       setSelectedBuildingId(firstBuildingId);
+       localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, firstBuildingId.toString());
+     }
+   }, [buildings, selectedBuildingId]);
+ 
+   // Verifica che l'edificio selezionato esista ancora
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (buildings &amp;&amp; selectedBuildingId) {
+       const exists = buildings.some(b =&gt; b.id === selectedBuildingId);
+       if (!exists &amp;&amp; buildings.length &gt; 0) {
+         // Edificio non più disponibile, seleziona il primo
+         const firstBuildingId = buildings[0].id;
+         setSelectedBuildingId(firstBuildingId);
+         localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, firstBuildingId.toString());
+       }
+     }
+   }, [buildings, selectedBuildingId]);
+ 
+   // Trova edificio selezionato
+   const selectedBuilding: Building | undefined = buildings?.find(
+     b =&gt; b.id === selectedBuildingId
+   );
+ 
+   // Handler per cambiare edificio
+   const selectBuilding = (buildingId: number) =&gt; {
+     setSelectedBuildingId(buildingId);
+     localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, buildingId.toString());
+   };
+ 
+   // Clear selezione
+   const clearSelection = () =&gt; {
+     setSelectedBuildingId(null);
+     localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
+   };
+ 
+   return {
+     buildings: buildings || [],
+     selectedBuilding,
+     selectedBuildingId,
+     selectBuilding,
+     clearSelection,
+     isLoading,
+     error,
+     hasBuildings: (buildings?.length || 0) &gt; 0,
+   };
+ };
+ 
```

```diff
+ 
+ ## 🎯 Funzionalità Implementate
+ 
+ ### 1. Google Maps Integration
+ 
+ **Componente:** &#96;AddressAutocomplete&#96;
+ 
+ **Funzionalità:**
+ - Ricerca indirizzi con Google Places Autocomplete
+ - Preview mappa interattiva con marker
+ - Estrazione automatica coordinate GPS (lat/lng)
+ - Rilevamento automatico timezone
+ - Validazione indirizzo con dettagli completi
+ 
+ **Configurazione richiesta:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Frontend .env
+ VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-api-key
+ 
+ # Backend .env
+ GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-api-key
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Documentazione:** &#96;doc/GOOGLE_MAPS_SETUP.md&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### 2. Building Onboarding Page
+ 
+ **Pagina:** &#96;/onboarding&#96; (o &#96;/buildings/new&#96;)
+ 
+ **Funzionalità:**
+ - Form creazione edificio con validazione
+ - Campo nome edificio (min 3 caratteri)
+ - Campo indirizzo con Google Autocomplete
+ - Preview mappa con marker posizione
+ - Salvataggio automatico coordinate e timezone
+ - Design responsive con gradiente accattivante
+ 
+ **Flusso:**
+ 1. Utente inserisce nome edificio
+ 2. Utente cerca e seleziona indirizzo
+ 3. Sistema mostra preview mappa
+ 4. Sistema estrae coordinate e timezone
+ 5. Utente conferma e crea edificio
+ 6. Redirect a Dashboard
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### 3. Building Selector in Header
+ 
+ **Componente:** &#96;Header&#96; (aggiornato)
+ 
+ **Funzionalità:**
+ - Dropdown selezione edificio attivo
+ - Icona edificio con nome
+ - Pulsante "Nuovo Edificio" nel dropdown
+ - Persistenza selezione in localStorage
+ - Auto-selezione primo edificio disponibile
+ 
+ **Hook:** &#96;useSelectedBuilding&#96;
+ - Gestione stato edificio selezionato
+ - Persistenza localStorage
+ - Auto-selezione intelligente
+ - Validazione esistenza edificio
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### 4. Hook Aggiornati per Building-Centric
+ 
+ **Hook modificati:**
+ 
+ #### &#96;useDevices({ buildingId })&#96;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const { devices, isLoading } = useDevices({ 
+   buildingId: selectedBuildingId 
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ - Filtra dispositivi per edificio
+ - Disabilita query se buildingId è null
+ - Backward compatible (funziona senza buildingId)
+ 
+ #### &#96;useEnergyStats({ buildingId })&#96;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const { stats, isLoading } = useEnergyStats({ 
+   buildingId: selectedBuildingId 
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ - Statistiche energia per edificio
+ - Cache separata per edificio
+ - TODO: Implementare filtro building_id lato backend
+ 
+ #### &#96;useRealTimeData({ buildingId })&#96;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const { realTimeData, summary } = useRealTimeData({ 
+   buildingId: selectedBuildingId 
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ - Dati real-time filtrati per edificio
+ - WebSocket con subscription per edificio
+ - Polling fallback con filtro building_id
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### 5. Task Celery per Meteo Automatico
+ 
+ **Task:** &#96;collect_weather_data&#96;
+ 
+ **Funzionalità:**
+ - Esecuzione automatica ogni 15 minuti
+ - Fetch dati meteo per tutti gli edifici con coordinate GPS
+ - Salvataggio in tabella &#96;building_weather&#96;
+ - Supporto OpenWeatherMap e WeatherAPI
+ - Gestione errori e retry automatico
+ 
+ **Dati raccolti:**
+ - Temperatura attuale e percepita
+ - Umidità e pressione
+ - Velocità vento
+ - Condizioni meteo (clear, clouds, rain, etc.)
+ - Orari alba/tramonto
+ 
+ **Task:** &#96;cleanup_weather_history&#96;
+ 
+ **Funzionalità:**
+ - Esecuzione automatica ogni giorno alle 04:00 UTC
+ - Elimina record meteo più vecchi di 30 giorni
+ - Ottimizzazione spazio database
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🔧 Configurazione Richiesta
+ 
+ ### 1. Variabili Ambiente Backend
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Google APIs
+ GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-google-maps-api-key
+ 
+ # Weather API (scegli uno)
+ WEATHER_API_PROVIDER=openweathermap  # o 'weatherapi'
+ OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY=your-openweathermap-key
+ # oppure
+ WEATHERAPI_KEY=your-weatherapi-key
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 2. Variabili Ambiente Frontend
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Google Maps API
+ VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your-google-maps-api-key
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 3. Installazione Dipendenze Backend
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ cd modules/backend
+ pip install googlemaps==4.10.0
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+

+ ## 🚀 Come Usare
+ 
+ ### 1. Primo Accesso Utente
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // L'utente viene automaticamente reindirizzato a /onboarding
+ // se non ha edifici configurati
+ 
+ // In ProtectedRoute.tsx (da implementare):
+ const { data: buildings } = useBuildings();
+ if (buildings &amp;&amp; buildings.length === 0) {
+   navigate('/onboarding');
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 2. Creazione Edificio
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { useCreateBuilding } from '@/hooks/useBuildings';
+ 
+ const { mutateAsync: createBuilding } = useCreateBuilding();
+ 
+ await createBuilding({
+   name: "Casa Principale",
+   address: "Via Roma 1, Milano, MI, Italia",
+   latitude: 45.4642,
+   longitude: 9.1900,
+   timezone: "Europe/Rome",
+   place_id: "ChIJ...",
+   address_components: { ... }
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 3. Selezione Edificio
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { useSelectedBuilding } from '@/hooks/useSelectedBuilding';
+ 
+ const { 
+   selectedBuilding, 
+   selectedBuildingId,
+   selectBuilding,
+   buildings 
+ } = useSelectedBuilding();
+ 
+ // Cambia edificio
+ selectBuilding(newBuildingId);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 4. Filtrare Dati per Edificio
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { useDevices } from '@/hooks/useDevices';
+ import { useSelectedBuilding } from '@/hooks/useSelectedBuilding';
+ 
+ const { selectedBuildingId } = useSelectedBuilding();
+ const { devices } = useDevices({ buildingId: selectedBuildingId });
+ 
+ // devices contiene solo i dispositivi dell'edificio selezionato
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🧪 Testing
+ 
+ ### Test Manuale
+ 
+ 1. **Creazione Edificio:**
+    - Vai su &#96;/onboarding&#96;
+    - Inserisci nome edificio
+    - Cerca indirizzo con autocomplete
+    - Verifica che la mappa mostri il marker
```

```diff
+    - **Frontend key** (con restrizioni HTTP referrer)

+

+ WEATHER_API_PROVIDER=openweathermap

+ ## ❓ FAQ

+ ### Q: Posso usare l'app senza Google Maps API?

+ ### Q: Quanto costa Google Maps API?

+ ### Q: Posso avere più edifici?

+ ### Q: Come funziona il task meteo?
```

```diff
+ ## 💡 Note Tecniche
+ 
+ ### Architettura
+ 
+ L'implementazione segue il pattern **Building-Centric**:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ Users (N) ↔ (M) Buildings (1) → (N) Devices
+                     ↓
+               Weather Data (1:N)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Hook Pattern
+ 
+ Gli hook sono stati aggiornati per supportare &#96;buildingId&#96; opzionale:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Backward compatible
+ const { devices } = useDevices(); // Tutti i dispositivi
+ 
+ // Building-aware
+ const { devices } = useDevices({ buildingId: 1 }); // Solo edificio 1
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Persistenza
+ 
+ La selezione edificio è persistita in &#96;localStorage&#96;:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ localStorage.setItem('selectedBuildingId', '1');
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Task Celery
+ 
+ I task meteo sono schedulati con RedBeat:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ 'collect-weather-data': {
+     'task': 'app.services.data_collector.collect_weather_data',
+     'schedule': 900.0,  # 15 minuti
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+
```

